brief.objective: Recommend a Transformer architecture that this team can implement from scratch.
constraints: Hypothetical hardware budget: one NVIDIA A100 GPU with 40 GB memory.
Target scale: approximately one billion parameters.
topics: Dense feed-forward layers versus sparse Mixture-of-Experts layers.
Whether to use dense, MoE, latent MoE, or interleaved hybrid layers.
A practical choice between 12 and 24 layers.
A practical model dimension such as 768 or 1024.
Training stability, inference efficiency, memory use, and implementation cost.
strict_notes: Use retrieved evidence for factual technical claims.
Cite exact sources and do not invent citations.
State uncertainty when the supplied evidence does not settle a claim.
